== Description ==

Players in a meeting room at the Hyatt Regency Peachtree on the Thursday night before the [[2022 World Championship]] in Atlanta, playing poker with chips and cards on a long table. The faces are not yet identified.

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #worlds-2022, Kendall Halman (Slack: Kendall Corran Halman), 13 October 2022 (21:20 Eastern), with the caption "Poker? I don't even know her!!". Original file name: IMG_5567.jpg (4032×3024); Slack file id F046GM7G0SE.
* '''Shared by:''' [[Kendall Halman]] (Slack: Kendall Corran Halman)
* '''Date:''' 13 October 2022, evening (Slack post at 21:20 Eastern).
* '''Identification:''' Faces are not yet identified. Clothing clues are on [[Unidentified event photographs]].

Unknown faces are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]]; if you recognise someone, please say so on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 SWCCG Forum] or this File's Talk page.
